text:
maya: Heads up — ACME pilot proposal landed with legal today. They want a private deployment (VPC + HSM) and a launch window ~6 weeks out. Asking for 99th-p50 latency SLA for conversational flows. Can we do a quick pass on what blocks/contenders look like?
shiv: 6 weeks is tight but doable if we trim scope. Is the SLA for all traffic or just a subset (e.g., pilot tenants)?
maya: pilot only — 2 tenants, steady qps ~30 rps peak, spiky during morning batch. They care about inference latency more than throughput.
emily (Runtime): For 99p we need to pin a model variant and an execution profile. If we use the `quant-8` profile we can hit cost targets, but 99p might slip for long contexts unless we enable adaptive batching prewarm.
noah: Infra note — private deployment needs dedicated subnet + NLBs and reserved nodes. We'll need to provision 2x gpus for canary and 4x for pilot. Lead time for on-prem appliances + HSM integration is ~3 weeks unless we re-use existing infra.
tara (Security): HSM/KMS integration + customer SOC review is a hard stop — we need an ATO checklist itemized. Also, audit logging retention for private must be configurable. I can fast-track the high-risk items if infra and eng give a concrete plan.
alex (SRE): From SLO side: 99p SLO is realistic if we do: 1) warm pools, 2) prefix KV caching for common prompts, 3) fallback to lower-cost model for non-critical requests. Need to confirm fallback policy with product.
maya: Product is OK with fallback for non-critical requests, but ACME wants an explicit behavior doc. They want predictable cost + a clear plan for graceful degradation.
shiv: Actionable engineering asks: 1) pin model and quant profile, 2) post-quant perf runbook, 3) runtime changes for prewarm + KV caching, 4) canary rollout plan. I estimate 2.5 weeks of infra+runtime work if infra is ready.
emily (Runtime): I'll prepare a perf matrix for model variants (float16, q8, q4) with 95/99/99.9 numbers. Quick snippet of perf harness we can reuse: ```python # perf harness example
run_benchmark(model='redwood-v1', profile='q8', seq=512, concurrent=16)
```
noah: I'll check node availability and whether we can repurpose the staging cluster. If we can, infra provisioning may drop to 4 days. Also need TLS certs for the NLB and route53 entries for private VPC endpoint.
tara (Security): Pre-reqs from security: HSM test keys, access matrix, and PCI-style separation doc. If infra can provide stubbed endpoints we can do an early review.
ops-oncall: FYI — burst prewarm will cause higher cost during business hours. We need to schedule a capacity ramp window and alerting thresholds: cpu/gpu queue depth > 60% -> escalate.
maya: Can we map owners + dates? Quick proposal: (A) model pin + perf matrix — emily — due in 4 business days; (B) infra provisioning & certs — noah — due in 7 business days; (C) security review & HSM stub — tara — due in 8 business days; (D) runtime prewarm + KV caching toggles — shiv/emily — due in 10 business days; (E) canary and runbook — alex — due in 12 business days. Does that feel achievable?
shiv: Sounds realistic if infra can repurpose staging. I'm concerned about the 99p tests — need synthetic workload generator. I can reuse `perf-harness` from runtime.
emily (Runtime): I'll attach the perf matrix to this thread when ready. Also recommend enabling per-tenant caching TTL to reduce tail variance.
noah: I'll confirm staging availability by EOD tomorrow. If unavailable we'll need procurement which adds ~2 weeks.
tara (Security): I'll start the ATO checklist and mark the top 5 blockers. If we get HSM stubs today, I can do initial review in 48 hours.
alex (SRE): I'll draft the runbook and the alert thresholds this week. Suggest adding an automated rollback if 99p regresses >5% over baseline during canary.
srebot: deploy-bot: New infra ticket created -> INFRA-1247 (private pilot nodes).
maya: Thanks team — next sync after confirmations. I'll draft the ACME-facing behavior doc (degradation + cost expectations) and circulate. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: Quick note — team should decide whether we allow cold starts for some low-priority routes; cold starts increase 99p a lot. Recommend marking low-priority routes as async.
shiv: Good call. We'll add a config flag `priority=high|low` and route low to async batch job.
maya: Final ask — please bump any blockers here ASAP. I want a go/no-go recommendation one week before the proposed launch window.
noah: Will update INFRA-1247 and link procurement answers.
tara (Security): Will upload checklist items and preliminary signoff status.
shiv: I'll start a small PR for the prewarm toggles and link it.
emily (Runtime): Perf matrix will be in by EOD+4.
maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
